items.exampleEn: Do you want sugar in your coffee?
We have three meals a day.
I buy a bottle of water every day.
I eat a bowl of rice for lunch.
We grow vegetables in our garden.

items.sentenceEn: I eat fruit and vegetables every day.

items.audioEn: Can you buy two bottles of water and some fruit?
items.audioZh: 你可以買兩瓶水和一些水果嗎？

items.sentenceZh: 晚餐是我最喜歡的一餐。

items.sentenceEn: Put the dishes in the kitchen, please.

items.stemEn: I'd like a ____ of soup, please.

items.passageEn: Lisa is healthy because she eats well. She has three meals a day. For breakfast, she has a bowl of fruit. For lunch, she has vegetables and a little meat. She never puts sugar in her tea. She always carries a bottle of water.
items.passageZh: Lisa 很健康，因為她吃得很好。她一天吃三餐。早餐她吃一碗水果，午餐吃蔬菜和一點肉。她喝茶從來不加糖。她總是隨身帶著一瓶水。

questions.questionZh: Lisa 總是隨身帶著什麼？

items.promptZh: 請不要在我的茶裡加糖。
referenceEn: Please don't put sugar in my tea.
No sugar in my tea, please.
rubricZh: 「加糖」可用 put sugar in（例如 put sugar in my tea）
否定的請求可用 Please don't…、No sugar, please 等

items.instructionZh: 用 vegetable 造一個句子，說說你喜歡或不喜歡的蔬菜。
referenceEn: I don't like vegetables very much.
rubricZh: 泛指蔬菜時用複數 vegetables（例如 I like vegetables、green vegetables）
可再補充蔬菜名稱（例如 Beans are my favorite vegetable.）
否定可用 don't（例如 I don't like vegetables）
